items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: So after he got off the set I says, “Hey man, Hank, what were you doing with your pedals man?” And he says, “Oh just trying to keep my feet busy.”

ctx.x: We were playing to a festival in France that had made a bunch of different outdoor stages and Hank Jones was playing and I was at stage — my eyes were at stage level and I could see his feet. And he was pumping the pedals while he was playing but I couldn’t hear what he was doing or what pedals he was pumping. So after he got off the set I says, “Hey man, Hank, what were you doing with your pedals man?” And he says, “Oh just trying to keep my feet busy.” He wouldn’t tell me.
